df[df['marks'] < 60]['marks'] = 60        # chained assignment
print(df)
print()

low = df[df['marks'] < 60]
low['marks'] = 60                         # changes only `low`
print(low)
print(df)
print()

df.loc[df['marks'] < 60, 'marks'] = 60    # the correct way
print(df)
print(pd.__version__)
